==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Using the self induced sleep paralysis method, I attained lucidity. I returned to the rebirth of the universe and found a white power ring.
An elf woman from another universe with a black bowl cut, pink skin, a green bodysuit, black leggings, and white boots appeared. She too had a white power ring.

She explained that the rings contain universal power. I meditate on the ring, and feel at one with the cosmos and the collective imagination of my friends.
